_notes: Register: both consoles are Sie. The job's existing cur had 22 du strings and 0 Sie (the de agency/university bundles are du/impersonal throughout); all 22 plus three du imperatives without a pronoun (docs.pick, inbox.pick, savedViews.saveHintEmpty) moved to Sie or infinitive labels. Buttons and labels stay infinitive/noun style ("Dokument zur Prüfung auswählen"). Owner decision: any du string in de/agency.json or de/university.json outside this job should be moved to Sie the same way.

Tone: Agency = short operational labels ("Antwort ausstehend", "Bewerbungsschluss in {{count}} Tagen"); University = formal/analytical ("Wo steigen Bewerbende aus?" replaced the colloquial "Wo verlieren wir sie?"; dropText now states the figures in English order).

university = «Hochschule» in all console copy (filters, columns, sidebars, picker, notes). Product names kept as the bundle has them: «Agentur-Konsole», «Universitäts-Konsole» (login titles follow). Hangyul HQ / Hangyul Operations stay as product names.

Glossary terms: application deadline = «Bewerbungsschluss» (apps.deadline, sortBy, ws.block.deadline_*, applicants.col.deadline, guide.field.deadline); task due = «fällig»; generic «Frist» only where the English deadline is not a university closing date (today.deadlines/upcoming lists mix both). admission letter = «Zulassungsschreiben», standard admission letter = «Standard-Zulassungsschreiben»; interview = «Auswahlgespräch»; mock interview = «Probeinterview»; vault = «Dokumentensafe» (ws.docsHint said «Dokumentenordner»); service period = «Leistungszeitraum»; additional service = «Zusatzleistung»; apostille / konsularische Legalisation / notarielle Beglaubigung as in common; visa issued = «erteilt» (af.stepName.VISA_ISSUED and ws.visaIssued aligned); funnel = «Zulassungstrichter».

Gender-neutral: removed every slash form (Studierende/r, Bewerber/in, Administrator/innen, Absolvent/innen, der/die). Singular person = «studierende Person» / «bewerbende Person»; plural «Studierende» / «Bewerbende»; staff = «Personal», «Mitarbeitende», «Kolleginnen und Kollegen» once (team.disableText); «die Administration» for 'an administrator / admin'.

Meaning fixes beyond nulls: dropped instructions restored (apps.empty, v22.work.emptyFiltered, v22.ws.noConversation, settings.noTeam); docs.sc.changes 'Request correction'; v22.stageHint.documents_check no longer adds 'das Büro'; stageHint.received no longer says 'formal geprüft – Prüfung öffnen'; v28.pipe.* now 'Outcomes to date'; v25.in.offerRate = Zusagequote (was Zulassungsquote); v22.work.closedHint 'not admitted' (was 'abgelehnt').

Plurals: German _one/_other; every _one carries {{count}}. Families present only as _other in the job (dash.days_other, misc.days_other/hours_other, students.bulk.*_other, team.count_other, work.total_other, applicants.customStatus_other, docFix/docReview_other) were translated with the plural noun. evidence.age/ageDays are a dt/dd pair, rendered «Höchstalter des Dokuments» / «{{count}} Tage».
Owner decision: intake stays «Semesterstart» (bundle term in both consoles) although the university bundle elsewhere uses «Aufnahmetermin» 7×; pick one bundle-wide.
